WITH r AS (
 SELECT r.*, p.subcategory sub_ret, p.sku, s.product_key s_pk, s.sale_date, s.quantity sold_qty, ps.subcategory sub_sale, s.channel_code
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
 LEFT JOIN dim_product ps ON ps.product_key=s.product_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND (p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' OR ps.subcategory='Garden Furniture'))
SELECT sub_ret, sub_sale, count(*) n, sum(quantity_returned) units,
 sum(case when sale_date is null then 1 else 0 end) no_sale,
 sum(case when sale_date>return_date then 1 else 0 end) ret_before_sale,
 sum(case when quantity_returned>sold_qty then 1 else 0 end) over_qty,
 sum(case when s_pk<>product_key then 1 else 0 end) pk_diff,
 sum(case when cast(return_ts_utc as date)<>return_date then 1 else 0 end) ts_date_diff,
 count(distinct sales_line_id) dist_sl
FROM r GROUP BY 1,2

FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-08-31' AND (r.return_date IN (DATE '2026-08-02', DATE '2026-08-03', DATE '2026-08-30', DATE '2026-08-31') OR hour(r.return_ts_utc)>=20 OR hour(r.return_ts_utc)<2)
ORDER BY 3
